indicator_convention: the 'ATR' is the absolute close-to-close move (AH-02), preserved as the legacy convention; a true-range variant exists as a separate research revision
blockers: BLOCKED_CAPABILITY: the canonical three-rung partial ladder needs a next-open entry, a protective stop and partial reduce-only exits on ONE route. intrabar_bracket_v1 provides the first two but a single take-profit level; the orders route provides the ladder but fills the entry at the stamped bar's close and rejects stop_market. Measured, not assumed.

declared_reduced_fidelity_variant.rule: results from this variant are labelled and may never be reported as the canonical A-HASH; the partial-exit thesis is not being tested by it
